correctness.rationale: On weighted A^2_alpha, angular orthogonality gives the exact monomial Toeplitz action and a single-diagonal commutator with c_n=[R_r(n)R_p(n+ell)-R_p(n)R_r(n+k)]/sqrt(R_m(n)). The moment ratio product yields quadratic numerator coefficient (alpha+1)(qr-ps). When qr=ps, primitive exponent vectors (p,q)=u(a,b),(r,s)=v(a,b) give cubic coefficient -(alpha+1)abuv(a-b)(u-v). All coefficient-vanishing cases commute: identity, analytic, coanalytic, radial or identical symbols. Counting the nonzero weighted-shift singular values proves n^-2/n^-3 sharp asymptotics and iff Schatten thresholds 1/2,1/3; logarithmic Cesaro sums yield critical Dixmier residues. Independently evaluated exact rational c_n for generic and resonant examples at n=200000, matching predicted constants; read symbolic checker source, which tests coefficient identities and finite matrix entries. Such finite checks are not an infinite proof.
